name: MATH 2705W
title: Technical Writing in Mathematics
description: An introduction to the communication of mathematics through formal writing.
requirement_description: ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011, and MATH 1132Q or 2141Q; completion of or concurrent enrollment in either MATH 2110Q, 2142Q, 2210Q, or 2410Q; open only to Mathematics majors.
